# Lustique Co. — full reference

Source: https://www.lustiqueco.co.za
This document expands the concise summary in /llms.txt with our services, full
price schedule, frequently asked questions and editorial content. All facts are
taken from the studio's own configuration; nothing here is estimated or invented.

## Who we are

- Name: Lustique Co. (legal name: Lustique Cosmetology)

### Areas served

Pretoria & surrounds · Johannesburg & surrounds · Gauteng-wide · Destination
weddings on request.

### Opening hours

- Studio trials: by appointment, Tuesday–Saturday.
- Wedding mornings: from first light, we travel to you.

## Services

### Bridal makeup — from R850

- Full trial at our studio, if you'd like one
- Skin prepared and primed for a long day
- Day-of makeup, plus a touch-up kit
- A look built to read beautifully in photographs

### Bridal hair — from R495

- Trial styling so we agree the finish in advance
- A style matched to your hair's own weight and movement
- Pins, product and hold that last the whole day
- Priced by length: short through extra long

### The whole party

- Flat makeup rates by role, from flower girls to guests
- Hair priced by length for every member of the party
- A running order built around your ceremony time
- Optional additional artists for larger groups

### Events & occasions — from R550

- Event makeup and hair, priced per person
- Matric farewells at a flat rate per face
- Meet at the venue, or come to the studio
- Travel calculated and confirmed up front

## Full price schedule (ZAR)

Bride
- Makeup, day: R850 — Makeup, trial: R850
- Hair: short R495 · medium R595 · long R695 · extra long R795

Bridal party
- Makeup: bridesmaid R550 · mother R500 · guest R550 · flower girl (12+) R500 ·
  flower girl (under 12) R250
- Hair: short R395 · medium R495 · long R595 · extra long R695
- Flower girl (under 12) hair: short R200 · medium R250 · long R300 · extra long R400

Events
- Makeup: R550 — Hair: short R395 · medium R495 · long R595 · extra long R695

Beyond-bridal flat per face
- Matric farewell R750 · Editorial R750 · Engagement R650 · Corporate R650 ·
  Pageant R950

Group lessons
- R700 per face for groups under 10; R600 per face at 10 or more (minimum 6).

Extras & travel
- Additional artist: R850
- Travel: free within 40 km round trip; R7 per km round trip beyond that.
  Destination travel (200 km+ one way) quoted on request; destination
  accommodation estimate R1000 per artist per night.

## Current promotion

Book hair & makeup for four or more full looks and the least-expensive eligible
look is on us. The bride always counts toward the threshold but is never freed;
an under-12 flower girl is never freed; a trial is never freed.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Do you travel to me on the day?
A: Yes. We come to you on the wedding morning. Travel within 40 km round trip of
our La Montagne studio is free; beyond that we charge R7 per km round trip, and
we confirm the exact figure before you book.

Q: Is a trial included?
A: A bridal trial is included in the bridal estimate and takes place at our
studio. You can opt out of the trial when you build your estimate.

Q: Can you look after my whole bridal party?
A: Yes. Bridesmaids, mothers, flower girls and guests can all be added to your
estimate, and you can request up to two additional artists for larger groups.

Q: How do I secure my date?
A: Send an enquiry through the estimator and we will confirm availability and
next steps with you directly.

Q: Why does my estimate change when I change my hair length?
A: Hair is priced by length — short, medium, long and extra long — because longer
and thicker hair takes more time to prepare and style.

Q: How does the current offer work?
A: Book hair and makeup for four or more full looks and the least-expensive
eligible look is on us. The bride, under-12 flower girls and trials are never the
look that is freed.

Q: Do you do matric farewells and events?
A: Yes. Matric farewells are a flat rate per face, and we offer event makeup and
hair at the venue or in our studio. We also run group lessons.

Q: What should I bring to my appointment?
A: Inspiration photos, your hair accessory or jewellery if you have it, and your
questions. Arrive with a clean face and your hair in its usual state of washing.
